title: lint: the `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty` remedy tells authors the admin bulk import does not write `sys_user.manager_id`; it has since PR #18046
body:
Filing gate ①, class (a): a runtime string tells the author something false. reach: named real producer. `os lint` runs `@objectstack/lint`'s `validateApprovalApprovers`, and on a manager-only approver slate its rule `approval-approvers-may-resolve-empty` emits a hint containing "its admin bulk import does not write it either". This was measured on the built `@objectstack/lint` dist by the dev of #22662 (report on #22662, PR #22681). Filed by the `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023) · `marchtian` · `session_01Q7Fy4uVkvBWgj9CLihdATJ`. **Reader:** triage, then the lane that owns `packages/lint`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is false, and where

- `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.ts`, `MANAGER_ONLY_ROUTES` (about `:199` on `origin/main`), carries the clause.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-approval-approvers.test.ts` (about `:313`) pins the wording.

## What the product does (read on `origin/main`)

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts` admits a `manager_id` column. Its doc block reads "admitted, and resolved in a SECOND pass". The cell holds the manager's identity key (email or phone). The link is applied after every row exists, through `applyUserManagerLink`, the same derivation `POST /admin/set-user-manager` runs. It has done so since `d438b3a9aa` (PR #18046).

So the lint remedy sends authors away from a supported bulk path. This is the last known member of the "nothing writes `manager_id`" family. #22662 (PR #22681) corrects the two docs pages, and `automation/approvals.mdx` states that `os lint` "carries the same remedy text", so after PR #22681 lands the guide is one clause ahead of the lint string.

## Done when

- The remedy names the admin bulk import's `manager_id` column beside Set Manager and the endpoint, or drops the false clause.
- The pin asserts the corrected wording.
- A grep for "bulk import does not write" over `packages/lint/src`, `content/docs` and `skills/` is in the PR body.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack manager_id set-user-manager` earlier this shift gave 1 hit (#10153, closed, a different defect). The family's cards are #22584 (closed), #22662 (in flight, docs only) and #17995 (closed, `ApproverType.describe()`). Dedupe words: os lint manager remedy admin bulk import does not write manager_id.
